messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert for `inference-gateway`: high 5xx rate detected (p95 error-rate 6.2%, threshold 3%). Page fired to `sre-oncall`. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx · PD incident PD12345.

sre-oncall: Acked :rotating_light: I'm on it, starting triage — checking regions, pods, and recent deploys.

alice: I see the spike concentrated in eu-west1, upstream 502s from model-proxy. Timeline 00:02-00:07 UTC.

paul: K8s: scaling model-proxy pool +4, will drain suspected node. Running: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/model-proxy`.

emma: No model rollout in last 6h on runtime side. KV cache eviction metrics look high — possible cache pressure causing proxy failures.

alice: Logs excerpt:
```
[00:03:21] upstream reset while sending body to 10.4.12.7:5042
[00:03:22] kvcache: eviction_count=3245 miss_rate=0.67
[00:03:23] proxy: connection reset by peer
```

paul: +4 pods requested, 2 are ready now. Draining pod model-proxy-7f4a which shows repeated tcp resets. Shifting traffic.

luis-cs: FYI CS: Customer A and Customer B reported errors from EU at 00:04 UTC, both receiving 502s. CS triaging and preparing outbound.

sre-oncall: Routing change: divert eu-west1 traffic to `eu-canary` slice and enable short retries at edge (10s) to reduce client errors. Applying route policy now.

emma: Flushing KV cache on affected model-proxy nodes to clear pressure: `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/cache/flush` — executed on 2 nodes.

alice: After divert + cache flush p95 error-rate down to ~2.1%. Still seeing some tail errors from existing keepalive connections.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by sre-oncall at 1758123460.

paul: Rolling back an earlier config tweak that reduced connection pool timeouts (applied 03:15 UTC). Rollback complete.

alice: Error-rate holding ~1.5% over the last 3 minutes. No new error reports from synthetic probes.

luis-cs: CS notified affected tenants with a mitigation update. They'll re-open if users still see issues.

sre-oncall: Monitoring for 30m, will escalate if visible recurrence. Leaving incident in watch state. Thanks for the quick responses.

bob: Postmortem notes for later: likely combination of KV cache eviction spikes + transient upstream resets. Action items: add cache-eviction alert, increase cache headroom, and run a circuit-breaker test for model-proxy.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: incident PD12345 marked RESOLVED at 1758123799 by sre-oncall.
